failure_modes: Reducing surprise by avoiding all novelty
Model complexity that exceeds the compute available to run it
gloss: A system stays viable by continually predicting inputs and reducing surprise
invariants: The system carries an explicit or implicit prediction of incoming signals
Mismatch between prediction and input drives adaptation
mechanism: A system holds a model of what comes next, compares it with what arrives, and adjusts either its model or its actions to reduce the mismatch. Variational free energy minimization and the principle of least action are candidate first-principles framings of this drive.
